# Miller Front End Alignment

> Miller Front End Alignment is an owner-operated front-end and alignment shop in Amarillo, Texas, run by Terry, known for alignments on trucks, lifted vehicles and classic cars.

## Key facts
- Business: Miller Front End Alignment
- Owner: Terry
- Location: 1801 SW 3rd Ave, Amarillo, TX 79106
- Specialties: front-end alignment, suspension work, lifted truck alignments, classic car front ends, brakes, routine maintenance
- Rating: 4.9 stars from 98 Google reviews
- Tip: call ahead to book; Terry keeps a waiting list
- Phone: (806) 373-7520
- Address: 1801 SW 3rd Ave, Amarillo, TX 79106
- Hours: Mon – Thu 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM (call ahead); Fri – Sun Closed
- Services: Front-End Alignment, Suspension Work, Lifted Truck Alignments, Classic Car Front Ends, Brakes, Routine Maintenance
